content: Internal Revenue Service, Officer Daniel Reeves speaking. You have reached the IRS investigation hotline. May I have your full name for verification?
Um, yes, this is Priya Kumar. I just got a voicemail saying there is some problem with my taxes and I might be in trouble?

Ms. Kumar, thank you. I have pulled up your record. According to our audit under section 6331 of the Internal Revenue Code, there are significant discrepancies in your filed returns for the years 2020 and 2021. Are you aware of any outstanding tax liabilities?
No, I always file on time. I don't think I owe anything. I am really confused.

There appears to be an unpaid balance of $7,800, which includes penalties and interest for underreporting income. The IRS has already sent multiple notifications to your provided address. Did you not receive any correspondence?
No, I didn't get any letters. I moved recently. Is this about my H1B status? Will this affect my visa?

Ms. Kumar, failure to resolve unpaid federal taxes is a violation of Title 26 of the U.S. Code. This can result in immediate legal actions, including liens against your property and notification to immigration authorities. I must advise you to cooperate fully.
Wait, what do you mean legal actions? I could lose my job or be deported?

If this matter is not settled today, your assets can be frozen, wages garnished, and your case may be referred for criminal prosecution. I've noted your visa concerns; failure to comply will be reported to USCIS and could jeopardize your residency.
Please, I didn't do anything wrong. What do I need to do to fix this?

To halt further enforcement actions, you are eligible for an immediate resolution program. You must make a provisional settlement payment today to suspend the collection process. Are you prepared to resolve your outstanding IRS balance now?
Yes, I just want this to go away. How do I pay? Can I pay with my bank account?

Due to the severity and urgency of your case, only secured payment methods are accepted. This includes wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or government-approved reloadable gift cards such as Target or Best Buy. Which option can you complete right now?
Gift cards? I don't understand. Why would the IRS take gift cards?

This is a restricted settlement process monitored to prevent fraud. Gift card payments are instantly verifiable and ensure compliance. Delays or refusal to comply will result in your case being escalated and a warrant being issued in your name.
Oh my god, I can't have a warrant. Please don't report me. I will get the gift cards. How much do I need to get?

For initial compliance, you must provide $3,000 in Target or Best Buy gift cards within the next 45 minutes. Stay on the line. Read me the codes as soon as you purchase them. Do not disconnect or speak to anyone in the store, as this will appear as non-cooperation.
Okay, I will go to Target right now. Can you wait on the phone while I get the cards?

Yes, remain on the call at all times. If you hang up or delay, the IRS will proceed with asset seizure and notification to your employer and immigration authorities. Do you understand the seriousness of this?
Yes, I understand. I am leaving for the store now. Please don't take my job or call immigration.
